parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this {{object}} instance. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: The mechanism via which the {{object}} was created. If the CPE supports MAP configuration via both DHCPv6 and CWMP, it is up to the implementation to determine how the two mechanisms will interact.

parameters.name: IPv6Prefix
parameters.description: The ''Rule IPv6 prefix''. The Rule IPv6 prefix is a leading part of the end-user {{param|#.IPv6Prefix}}, i.e. its length MUST be less than or equal to the length of the end-user ''IPv6Prefix'', and it MUST match the end-user ''IPv6Prefix''. Corresponds to the {{bibref|RFC7598}} ''S46_RULE'' option's ''ipv6-prefix'' field.

parameters.name: IPv4Prefix
parameters.description: The ''Rule IPv4 prefix''. Corresponds to the {{bibref|RFC7598}} ''S46_RULE'' option's ''ipv4-prefix'' field.

parameters.name: EABitsLength
parameters.description: The length in {{units}} of the ''Embedded Address (EA) bits'' in the end-user {{param|#.IPv6Prefix}}. Corresponds to the {{bibref|RFC7598}} ''S46_RULE'' option's ''ea-len'' field.

parameters.name: IsFMR
parameters.description: Indicates whether this rule is a ''Forwarding Mapping Rule'' (FMR), i.e. can be used for forwarding. Corresponds to the {{bibref|RFC7598}} ''S46_RULE'' option's ''flags'' field's ''F-Flag''.

parameters.name: PSIDOffset
parameters.description: ''Port-set ID'' (PSID) offset in {{units}}. The number of Port-sets is 2^{{param}}^. Corresponds to the {{bibref|RFC7598}} ''S46_PORTPARAMS'' (Port Parameters) option's ''offset'' field.

parameters.name: PSIDLength
parameters.description: The length in {{units}} of the ''Port-set id'' (PSID) configured in the {{param|PSID}} parameter. Corresponds to the {{bibref|RFC7598}} ''S46_PORTPARAMS'' (Port Parameters) option's ''PSID-len'' field.

parameters.name: PSID
parameters.description: ''Port-set ID'' (PSID) to use in preference to the value extracted from the ''Embedded Address'' (EA) bits. Only the high order {{param|PSIDLength}} bits of the {{param}} value are used, so the parameter is ignored when {{param|PSIDLength}} is zero. Corresponds to the {{bibref|RFC7598}} ''S46_PORTPARAMS'' (Port Parameters) option's ''PSID'' field.

parameters.name: IncludeSystemPorts
parameters.description: Whether to include low-numbered (system) ports in the Port-sets. Normally ports in the range [0:2^(16-{{param|PSIDOffset}})^-1] are excluded, e.g. for the default {{param|PSIDOffset}} value of 6, ports [0:1023] are not included in the Port-sets. This parameter is related to {{bibref|RFC7597}}'s ''N'', which is defined as ''the number of ports (e.g., 1024) excluded from the lower end of the range''. The parameter is relevant only when {{param|PSIDOffset}} is 0; {{false}} corresponds to ''N=1024'' and {{true}} corresponds to ''N=0''.

object.description: The MAP domain's Mapping Rules {{bibref|RFC7597}}. The rule with the longest match between its {{param|IPv6Prefix}} and the end-user {{param|#.IPv6Prefix}} is the Basic Mapping Rule (BMR). Any of the rules (including the BMR) can be a Forwarding Mapping Rule.
